title: 店铺目标进度
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：查询2026年8月1日至22日每日店铺指标的GMV合计最高的5家店铺，返回店铺名称、该期间GMV、8月月度GMV目标和完成率，完成率为实际除以目标，保留4位小数。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql:
WITH period_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    dsm.store_id,
    SUM(dsm.gmv) AS period_gmv
  FROM daily_store_metrics dsm
  WHERE dsm.stat_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-22'
  GROUP BY dsm.store_id
),
aug_targets AS (
  SELECT
    st.store_id,
    SUM(st.gmv_target) AS aug_gmv_target
  FROM sales_targets st
  WHERE st.target_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY st.store_id
)
SELECT
  s.store_name AS "店铺名称",
  p.period_gmv AS "期间GMV合计",
  t.aug_gmv_target AS "8月GMV目标",
  ROUND(p.period_gmv / NULLIF(t.aug_gmv_target, 0), 4) AS "完成率"
FROM period_gmv p
JOIN stores s
  ON s.store_id = p.store_id
LEFT JOIN aug_targets t
  ON t.store_id = p.store_id
ORDER BY p.period_gmv DESC
LIMIT 5
